title: Holiday Destinations: Guides, Weather & Deals
description: Explore holiday destination guides with the best time to visit, what to expect and how to find deals, from the Canary Islands to Orlando and beyond.
cardText: Destination guides with when to go, what to expect and how to find deals.
intro: Not sure where to go? Our destination guides cover when to visit, what to expect and how to find the best deals.

image.alt: Whitewashed buildings and blue domes on a Greek island

sections.html:
• Canary Islands: year-round sunshine, volcanic landscapes and great-value all-inclusive options.
  • Orlando: the world’s theme park capital, perfect for family holidays.

We’re adding new destination guides regularly.

[[banner:cj6868393-b-italy-350]]

Start with when you can travel and how far you want to fly, then think about what kind of trip you want: beach, city, adventure or theme parks. Our city breaks page has ideas for short trips, and last-minute holidays can help if you’re flexible.

Once you’ve picked somewhere, compare fares: [[link:cj6868393-generic|Oojo]] is one of the flight booking sites we work with.

sections.h2: Check entry rules before you fall for a destination
sections.html:
Every destination has its own entry requirements, and they change. GOV.UK publishes foreign travel advice for each country, covering passport validity, visas and health. For Schengen countries such as Spain, it says a UK passport must have been issued less than 10 years before you arrive and have at least 3 months left on the day you leave. Read our passport validity guide and the EES and ETIAS explainer before booking.

Check too that the time of year suits you: our winter sun guide and Christmas market guide cover seasonal trips.

faqs.q: How do I choose a holiday destination?
faqs.a: Start with your travel dates and budget, then decide what kind of trip you want: beach, city break, theme parks or adventure. Check entry requirements on GOV.UK for the countries you are considering, then compare flights and accommodation.

faqs.q: Where can I find official entry requirements for a country?
faqs.a: GOV.UK's foreign travel advice has an entry requirements section for each country, covering passport validity, visas and health information. Check it again close to departure, as rules change.
